description: This file defines the 'EmployeeWorkShift' entity class using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models a many-to-one relationship between employees and work shifts in the HRM system, including getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShift
classes.description: Entity class representing the association between an Employee and a WorkShift in the HRM system.

methods.name: getWorkShift
methods.description: Returns the WorkShift associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: setWorkShift
methods.description: Sets the WorkShift associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.
